name: What is AEO and how does it benefit multi-location businesses?

mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how does it benefit multi-location businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or Answer Engine Optimization, focuses on making your business discoverable and authoritative in AI-powered search engines and voice assistants. For multi-location businesses, AEO ensures each physical location appears accurately and consistently when customers search for products or services nearby. It optimizes for specific location-based queries, driving local foot traffic and online engagement. By establishing your brand as a trusted source of information across all locations, AEO enhances overall visibility and captures a larger share of local markets, directly impacting sales and customer acquisition.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO optimizes your business for AI search and voice, ensuring all your physical locations are visible and authoritative in local searches, driving foot traffic and online engagement.
